name: demo-vm
notes: Eval-only virtual profile used by the example overlay.

steps.title: Boot the installer
steps.detail: PXE-boot the VM on the imaging network.

name: lenovo-t14-g4
notes: The workplace laptop the simulated fleet runs. Fingerprint reader needs its own driver; see the Hardware page.
disko: LUKS2 on nvme0n1, ext4 root, 1 GiB ESP

steps.title: Enter the firmware
steps.detail: F1 during boot. Set Secure Boot to setup mode so the console can enrol its keys.

steps.title: PXE-boot the installer
steps.detail: F12, pick the network entry the station serves.

steps.title: Confirm the target disk
steps.detail: nvme0n1 is wiped. There is no second disk in this model.

steps.title: Seal to the TPM
steps.detail: After the first boot the console seals the LUKS key; the recovery key is escrowed and the device forgets its copy.

name: hp-elitebook-840
notes: Second workplace model. Same disk layout as the Lenovo, different firmware key.
disko: LUKS2 on nvme0n1, ext4 root, 1 GiB ESP

steps.title: Enter the firmware
steps.detail: Esc then F10. Clear the Secure Boot keys to reach setup mode.

steps.title: Seal to the TPM
steps.detail: Same ceremony as every other model; the console drives it.

name: dell-latitude-5440
disko: LUKS2 on nvme0n1, ext4 root, 1 GiB ESP

steps.title: Enter the firmware
steps.detail: F2 during boot; Secure Boot to setup mode.

steps.title: Seal to the TPM
steps.detail: Driven by the console after first boot.
